title: Polynomial-time computability of dualization
statement: The function that maps each binary string $x$ to the encoding of the De Morgan dual, as a DNF formula, of the CNF formula decoded from $x$ is computable in polynomial time.
replaced:
The function that maps a binary string $x$ to the serialization of the De Morgan dual
of the CNF formula decoded from $x$ — the DNF obtained by negating every literal in
place — is polynomial-time computable.
